name: Laura Loomer
subject: Tonight started with Rebellion
body:
I'm surrounded by my family for the holiday, but I wanted to tell you . . . thank you.
| | | | [](https://libersend.loomered.com/l/bZPeCTAajmzyaMKwCIY0iA/EKMzwHUF79DBZHzkOAsPCg/q5DuTaxuC6N8pFt5wNsHaQ) | Patriot,

Tonight, I'll be celebrating the first night of Hanukkah. Hanukkah began with a rebellion, and this Hanukkah, I ask that all Americans and freedom loving people around the world channel that same spirit of rebellion in our mutual fight against the Radical Left and their plan to completely transform America, and Western Civilization for the worst.

Regardless of your religion, the story of Hanukkah relates to what is happening in America today.

2,188 years ago, soldiers of a Syrian tyrant, Antiochus IV Epiphanes, marched into Jerusalem and ruthlessly killed thousands of people and desecrated the Second Temple.

The Jews rebelled against their tyrant ruler and after years of fighting and sacrifice, drove the Syrians from their home.

Upon their victory, they rededicated the Second Temple, lighting a menorah which burned for eight nights despite only having enough oil to burn for a single night.

Today, our fight is just beginning.

As the radical Left is taking over our nation and changing the fabric of our society, all we need to do is look back at history for inspiration of how we can ultimately win as long as we keep up the fight.

Tonight, I ask that you take a moment with your family to light a candle.

As you do, look into the eyes of your children, of your husband or wife. Look into the eyes of those you love to know what you'll be fighting for and hold onto that moment.

Like the Jews who fought to take back their home 2,000 years ago, our struggle won't be easy. We will have moments of sacrifice, but in the end, we will rejoice as we claim victory over those who oppress our freedom and prosperity.

Like the first Hanukkah light that will be shining bright tonight, may your fighting spirit never go dim.

With love and respect.

Happy Hanukkah,

Laura Loomer

Making the leap to run for office is a tough decision to make, but we’re here to help you figure that out!
After attending Wednesday’s event, you’ll know how to evaluate making this decision, what to research, become comfortable with sharing this decision with those around you, and understand what resources are available depending on the office.
[RSVP NOW →](https://t.dripemail2.com/c/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..QDPuEQWLD5r1DibYsAOZGXwA1M5uK0dX1g6TI-lzs6A)

[RSVP NOW →](https://t.dripemail2.com/c/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..lyCHZ2pXs3E4cGsjiYRUbFNPj64vh2yVXgC3jGEdYGY)

[RSVP NOW →](https://t.dripemail2.com/c/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9._dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1ORFRDJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTExMjgyMV9SVSZfX3M9bzRibXVhcWpvbGMzcWhkcXZpc3kifQ.3mdNMLViANwGX6EG6IBC8fDgzatOu-zxXXBMu47s3Ik)

Bring your burning questions and make sure to RSVP soon as space is limited. ⇨ Then, we have Wednesday, December 1 at 1pm ET. Making the leap to run for office is a tough decision to make, but we’re here to help you figure that out! After attending Wednesday’s event, you’ll know how to evaluate making this decision, what to research, become comfortable with sharing this decision with those around you, and understand what resources are available depending on the office. ⇨ After that, there’s Thursday, December 2 at 1pm ET. Organizing isn’t just necessary during a big election year, it’s important all year-round! Progress is the result of consistency and in this training, our experts will explain why building your party’s infrastructure is so important during off-years. ⇨ We’re wrapping up the week with Friday, December 3 at 1pm ET. Structure is important when it comes to success. Our team of experts will help you understand why structure is necessary, explore examples of local party structures, and they will discuss gaps and how to increase leadership capacity! Mississippi Freedom Caucus joins letter to Joe Biden
On Thanksgiving Day, members of the Mississippi Freedom Caucus joined nearly 200 other state lawmakers from around the country demanding Joe Biden rescind his unconstitutional vaccine mandate. In the letter written by Rep. Stewart Jones, R-S.C., Rep. Tatum Lee, R-Kansas, and Rep. Josiah Magnuson, R-S.C. the state legislators say, “as State legislators, we took oaths to defend the Constitution of our state and of our country. We are thankful to live in the freest country in the world and we intend to keep it that way.” Rep. Dan Eubanks of the Mississippi Freedom Caucus led the charge and recruited 31 Mississippi legislators who signed onto the letter. The Mississippi Freedom Caucus is proud of the conservative legislators in Mississippi who are willing to stand up and fight for your rights. name: American Update
subject: For a limited time
body:
The events of the last year have no precedent in our nation’s history. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c8180%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=PNhYAabr%2fUEwxhMwcxWcSQ&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from American Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c18494%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=kMPI3%2ffVAXg19jTu0yJ%2fTA&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American,
The events of the last year have no precedent in our nation’s history. They’ve shaken me, and I’m sure they’ve affected you as well.
Throughout it all, you may have noticed a recurring theme from the progressives in the media, Big Tech, and politics. They insist that the government designed by our Founding Fathers, as expressed in the Constitution, is **flawed** and **outdated** --not adequate for the challenges of our time.
How should defenders of the Constitution, like you and me, respond to such charges?
Well, a few early champions of the Constitution--Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison--have given you the guide: _The Federalist Papers_.
Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution.
Thomas Jefferson described _The Federalist Papers_ as “the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written.”
That means that defenders of the Constitution have no better help in understanding the principles of liberty underlying our Constitution than the words of the Founders themselves.
**So, I’d like to send you our entire 10-lesson course, “ _The Federalist Papers_ ,”on DVD today with a donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.**
_**“The Federalist Papers”**_ course comes in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or a small group. You might also find it useful for a homeschool curriculum or personal study. It’s taught by Hillsdale’s knowledgeable faculty and will deepen your understanding of this incredibly relevant document even more.
The DVD can also make an excellent gift for a friend or family member unfamiliar with our nation’s founding principles of liberty. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c18405%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=bsSR%2f%2feGnNpiU0TA9VzX3g&sysid=1) Supplies are limited, though, so get this special edition of **_“The Federalist Papers”_** on DVD today. Given that more than 200,000 people have taken this course already, you can bet the DVD box set won’t last long.
Click here to learn more about this DVD and order your copy of _**“The Federalist Papers”**_ today: [**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-federalist-papers**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c18406%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=COBjk%2bYawOQ9UyQDCO7skA&sysid=1)
Warm regards,
Bill Gray
Class of 2001
Associate Vice President of National Donor Outreach
Hillsdale College
---

_Sponsored message_
Dear Friend, I'm writing this letter to you today because, quite frankly, David Daleiden cannot. You may remember David as the undercover journalist who spent 30 months investigating and capturing video evidence of Planned Parenthood 's top leadership --- medical directors, national program directors, even its Senior Director of Medical Services -- **callously negotiating the harvesting and sale of aborted baby body parts.** **And now, he’s been charged with nine bogus felonies.** **[Which is why I’m asking you to make an emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z6uap8ds8s4ulmdbkrofmcrj79fuejpg7ju32keg_rp22sh2s8i66pj0shgecor6cjh2bs)** You see, after David released the shocking videos of the illegal and disgusting actions of abortion executives, Kamala Harris, then California's Attorney General, colluded with Planned Parenthood to file felony charges against David... _**... Kamala Harris even ordered the California Department of Justice to raid David's home and confiscate his unpublished videos.**_ I won't sugarcoat it. If not cleared of these charges, David faces steep fines and years in state penitentiary and the consequences of being a convicted felon. While Kamala Harris --- a bought-and-paid-for ally of the abortion industry --- is sitting one heartbeat away from the presidency. That's the bad news. But here's the good news... David is fighting back. In fact, he's taking another opportunity to drag more of Planned Parenthood's dark criminality into the spotlight with two new federal lawsuits. That's right. The Thomas More Society has filed a federal civil rights lawsuit in California on behalf of David against former California Attorney General and now VicePresident Kamala Harris for prosecuting David in bad faith, twisting and perverting California's anti-eavesdropping law to persecute a citizen journalist because of his political views. Then the Thomas More Society filed a defamation (libel) lawsuit in federal court in New York against Planned Parenthood, which said David created a "fake" and "false" "smear campaign" against Planned Parenthood. In other words, the best defense is a good offense. The truth is we could no longer let David suffer such a trampling of his free speech and due process rights without a counterattack. The timing couldn't be more important. This is a critical opportunity to put Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the rest of the abortion industry on trial for conspiring to silence David in order to cover-up their illegal activities. **[That's where your emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND comes in --- by giving today you can stand with David in his hour of need.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z36uva1upln5ous0f9jed33i7n4rn0dt4t0su45o_rp22sh2s8i66pj0shgecor6cjh2bs)** The reality is. . . You couldn't be there when David entered the dark underbelly of the abortion industry --- sitting across the table from abortionists haggling over the price of baby body parts with cold-blooded clarity... "I want a Lamborghini." You couldn't be there as David saw with his own eyes the preborn children who had been killed with great precision and delicacy to preserve their organs for maximum profit. You couldn't be there when the videos were released and Kamala Harris and Planned Parenthood conspired to crush David with trumped up legal charges and an armed raid on his home in which they seized laptops, hard-drives, and recording equipment. And you couldn't be there with David (our criminal defense team was there) when he voluntarily appeared in both Texas and California for booking and processing --- fingerprinted and photographed for a mugshot like a common criminal. But, now, this is the reality... there is something you can do. **[You can make an emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND to help vindicate this pro-life hero.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zphcu50l7avpavo7fhnaertk6fr65krp11et5rn0_rp22sh2s8i66pj0shgecor6cjh2bs)** My name is Tom Brejcha. I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society --- a not-for-profit law firm underwriting and helping to spearhead David's criminal defense. The Thomas More Society is proud to have defended many renowned pro-life and religious leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe, Ann, and Eric Scheidler, the Pro-Life Action League, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, David Bereit, Lila Rose and Live Action, Students for Life, Sidewalk Advocates for Life, Created Equal, former Kansas Attorney General Phill Kline, the March for Life, and many more. Because when dark forces like Planned Parenthood unleash their full might to legally, financially, and personally destroy our clients --- **we fight back.** I have to tell you, despite all that David is facing, his spirits remain high. Of course, I've never known anyone in this kind of position who didn't feel an empty pit in his stomach. But David's not giving up. His willingness to fight back is a true profile in Pro-Life courage. Now I'll get right down to it... **We anticipate David's legal defense will cost us more than $6 million. That's right, SIX MILLION DOLLARS.** In addition to the criminal case and the new federal civil rights and defamation lawsuits, we're currently representing David in THREE other cases.
* The civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood where we are appealing the jury's verdict, along with the judge's order permanently banning David from doing any more undercover journalism against Planned Parenthood. Recently, we posted a $700,000 appeal bond to keep Planned Parenthood’s nasty collection agents from harassing him with collection agents and even seizing his belongings. We’re fighting back, but we’ll need your help.

* The civil lawsuit brought by the National Abortion Federation and the "gag order" injunction that still prohibits David from releasing any more of his video evidence exposing Planned Parenthood's illegal fetal tissue business. And now, in light of the Planned Parenthood civil lawsuit, NAF has moved for summary judgment – they want a ruling against David without a trial at all!

* And finally, the civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood personnel in federal court in Seattle, where we just achieved a victory for a second time on appeal, but it appears we may need at least a third victory on appeal before this case ends.

That's why David needs your financial support today. **[And that's why I'm praying you will donate $35 or more to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zsqq5mv3m9e1pc1h17bhvpm3cjn2q4rtuaqfm980_rp22sh2s8i66pj0shgecor6cjh2bs)** I won't guess how much you're able to send today. Whether it's $35, $50, $75, $125, $250, $500, $1,000 or more... ... I will only say that time is of the essence. So I do ask that you make your donation as soon as you can. **This truly is a "David versus Goliath" type of battle --- with Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the radical left arrayed against our "David."** It's a grave injustice that David is the one being hit with felony charges and massive civil penalties while Planned Parenthood (so far, at least) has gone unpunished. By clearing David of these charges... you and I can allow him to continue with his incredibly important lifesaving work. Remember, over 12 million people on YouTube alone watched the shocking footage he captured. Since that time, 26 states --- over half the country -- have moved to strip Planned Parenthood of taxpayer funding. It's no wonder Planned Parenthood and their allies want to destroy David. They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal and inhumane activities. You and I cannot let that happen. **[So please don't delay. Donate $35, $50, $100, or more to stand with David Daleiden today.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zuqehes10eldu5cldr3iavo2qesstq97hn2tlcpg_rp22sh2s8i66pj0shgecor6cjh2bs)** I've asked my staff to let me know as soon as we get it so I can let David know that you're standing with him. I know he'll be deeply touched by your generous support. May God Bless You, Tom Brejcha
President & Chief Counsel P.S. Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and their allies want to destroy David. They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal, ghoulish activities. You and I cannot let that happen. Can I count on you to support the official criminal defense of David Daleiden? **[David is a pro-life hero. name: Trump News HQ
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.
_Sponsored message_
This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zuc2cu30mb60kks0nqaq2hmjpnh8iinrjcvng9s8_rp22sh2s8i66pj0shgecor2cph2bs) Dear Fellow American, Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. subject: Unlock the Federalist Papers
body:
The events of the last year have no precedent in our nation’s history. They’ve shaken me, and I’m sure they’ve affected
| _Sponsored message_ |
---|---|---
This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zpknngl350322q8h71o50pddsv7b876pfqfsf9c0_rp22sh2s8i66pj0shgeeoj1chh2bs) Dear Fellow American, The events of the last year have no precedent in our nation’s history. They’ve shaken me, and I’m sure they’ve affected you as well. Throughout it all, you may have noticed a recurring theme from the progressives in the media, Big Tech, and politics. They insist that the government designed by our Founding Fathers, as expressed in the Constitution, is **flawed** and **outdated** —not adequate for the challenges of our time. How should defenders of the Constitution, like you and me, respond to such charges? Well, a few early champions of the Constitution—Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison—have given you the guide: _The Federalist Papers_. Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Thomas Jefferson described _The Federalist Papers_ as “the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written.” That means that defenders of the Constitution have no better help in understanding the principles of liberty underlying our Constitution than the words of the Founders themselves. **So, I’d like to send you our entire 10-lesson course, “ _The Federalist Papers_ ,”on DVD today with a donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.** _**“The Federalist Papers”**_ course comes in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or a small group. You might also find it useful for a homeschool curriculum or personal study. It’s taught by Hillsdale’s knowledgeable faculty and will deepen your understanding of this incredibly relevant document even more. The DVD can also make an excellent gift for a friend or family member unfamiliar with our nation’s founding principles of liberty. [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z6ehliak0gqtr41h0ics7fi8tfunftcjc215ac1o_rp22sh2s8i66pj0shgeeoj1chh2bs) Supplies are limited, though, so get this special edition of **_“The Federalist Papers”_** on DVD today. Given that more than 200,000 people have taken this course already, you can bet the DVD box set won’t last long. Click here to learn more about this DVD and order your copy of _**“The Federalist Papers”**_ today: [**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-federalist-papers**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zopcp4pf2u5f7fegdrarif6qf5emb4tpcaveqnd0_rp22sh2s8i66pj0shgeeoj1chh2bs) Warm regards, Bill Gray Class of 2001 Associate Vice President of National Donor Outreach Hillsdale College

My wife, Meghann, and I are both working parents, which I’m sure many of you know plenty about. The morning starts early with getting jumped on by kiddos who are ready to play and immediately eat breakfast. We get them off to daycare and school and then the work day begins.
When I’m campaigning, that means I’m off knocking on doors, talking to folks across WNC, and working with our team to make sure we’re hitting our weekly fundraising goals. I also have a job as Director of the Campaign for Southern Equality and my duties as a County Commissioner.
Evenings are wild...getting dinner on the table, cleaning up the tornado created by dinner, the twins bathed and in bed, playing board games and reading or watching some cartoons with Calvin, trying to find a few minutes so Meghann and I can catch up and hear a little about each other’s days. Her days are just as full as mine, plus she is supporting me in this campaign, which means lots of evenings and weekends when I’m out at events.
Our campaign is rooted in these daily realities, it’s a family endeavor through and through. And I share all this because I know some version of this is what a typical day looks like for a lot of people in our district.
You’re always juggling, trying to figure out how to be in two places at once, trying to ignore how exhausting the past 18+ months have been because of the pandemic. And if daycare or schools closes unexpectedly, it’s all a scramble.
We need policies that support working families to make life easier, not harder. I believe we need universal childcare and strong investments into our education system for both teachers and students. We need better healthcare access so that our children can grow up safe and healthy. We need stronger gun safety laws so that not one more life is put at risk while attending school.
I’m not your typical candidate, Peter. I don’t have the background that many politicians do. But I understand what Western NC families are going through because I’m going through it too.
**That’s why I’m running for Congress and that’s what makes me the strongest candidate to pave a new path forward for our community -- but I can’t win this race without your help.**

## We Are At WAR Right Now...
---
Currently, our nation is in the midst of a war. This war is a philosophical, cultural, informational and spiritual war for the heart and soul of America. Contrary to popular belief the biggest problem we face is not radical Democrats but instead weak Republicans (RINO's) that have enabled and empowered the radical democratic agenda. We DO NOT have a Democrat problem as much as we have a Republican problem. We MUST clean up our house to win this war for future generations. Oklahoma has a choice between 2 JL's for the US Senate - Jackson Lahmeyer & James Lankford. Lankford is a career politician that supported amnesty for illegal immigrants, opposed Trump's border wall, certified the stolen election of 2020 and apologized to BLM groups for questioning the 2020 election results. Learn more at www.RealJamesLankford.com Unlike James Lankford, I am not a career politician. I am a pastor and a small business owner from the Tulsa area. As a pastor I fought against Lockdowns and Mask Mandates in 2020. This year I have signed over 50,000 COVID19 Religious Exemption forms which has helped thousands of Americans keep their jobs without being forced to take the jab. In every war there are strategic battles that must be won. The US Senate race in Oklahoma is one of those strategic battles that is a MUST win for 2022. That is why I have been endorsed by General Michael Flynn, Sebastian Gorka, Mike Lindell, Roger Stone, Wendy Rogers and so many other Trump allies. People ask all the time: "Why are these national figures coming to Oklahoma so often?" The answer is because Oklahoma is a MUST win in this war for the heart and soul of America. In order to win this particular battle, I need YOUR help! Whether you are from Oklahoma or not this Senate race will impact you because there are only 100 Senators and the decisions made in the Senate impact all Americans. In a very short amount of time, I have raised over $500,000 from more than 4000 individual donors which is amazing. Unfortunately, Lankford may not have as many donors but he has big corporations and PACs behind him like Pfizer & the Blackstone Group that has helped him pad his bank account with around $2.5 million. We have to raise $100,000+ this December so we are ready for 2022 when everything intensifies. This is where I need your help. Lankford might be able to get 10 people to donate $2500 but I believe we can get 2500 people to donate $10. Here is my ask: please consider giving $1 each day for the month of December. If around 3000 people give $1 each day in December, we will raise $100,000 and be ready for 2022. If you unable to afford $1 each day that's ok because every dollar helps. If you are able to do more that would be incredible. I need your help to win this strategic battle in Oklahoma so we can win the war in America. To become a partner in this war, go to www.jacksonlahmeyer.com/donate and know that every dollar you give is a bullet we will use to win this battle. For those that give $30 or more during the month of December, a special conference call invitation will be given to join me and a special guest that has endorsed me to hear insights of what is happening all around America. If you have previously donated to the campaign know that I am extremely grateful for you and your willingness to help fund this fight; we would not be this far in the journey without you! Thank you so much for your support,
Jackson Lahmeyer

When it comes to helping everyday people, you know I never back down from a fight, no matter how large or small – I'll fight tooth and nail to protect the voiceless and defend the vulnerable from this country's wealthiest and most powerful interests.
I have always fought – _and_ _will always fight_ – to make meaningful progress for every last New Yorker in this state. That means suing Big Pharma for fueling the opioid crisis. As for the current Iowa senator, Chuck Grassley, it’s a different story. He's held this seat in the Senate for more than 40 years. And showing up for Iowa's working families seems to be a thing of his past. body:
I've given up my career to run for Congress with the intention of holding Washington bureaucrats more accountable. Don't want to receive our emails? [Unsubscribe here.]({{unsubscribeUrl}}) | [](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/59229642:sLNVZuHN9:m:1:2247059263:810B439607065EB100F8483C28AF527E:r)
---

Peter,

My name is John Castorani, and like a lot of other political candidates whose emails wind up in your inbox **I'm hoping you'll give me 30-seconds to a minute to explain why I'm reaching out to you today.**

I'm a 29-year-old conservative from central Virginia and I love this country of ours with all of my heart. Until earlier this year I was a member of the United States intelligence community.**I deployed seven times with the Army's Special Operations Command hunting radical Islamic terrorists across the Islamic MAGREB and in continental Africa. The men my team and I were charged with hunting down and capturing, in every case, posed an existential threat to democratic countries around the world, and I'm proud to say for that for 11 years my job was to track down and eliminate threats to your family and my own**.

[](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/59229642:sLNVZuHN9:m:1:2247059263:810B439607065EB100F8483C28AF527E:r)

Upon the election of Joe Biden to the presidency **[I gave up my career in the intelligence service- along with my security clearance - to run for Congress](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/59229642:sLNVZuHN9:m:1:2247059263:810B439607065EB100F8483C28AF527E:r)**. I did this because I'm scared to death that Biden is going to repeat the same mistakes of President Obama, and we're all going to pay the price.

If your interest is still piqued, I'm counting on you to continue reading.**As I said, I've given up my career to run for Congress with the intention of holding Washington bureaucrats more accountable** , and in a moment, [**I'm going to humbly ask for your financial assistance regarding my campaign.**](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/59229642:sLNVZuHN9:m:1:2247059263:810B439607065EB100F8483C28AF527E:r)

You may recall the attacks on the United States consulate in Benghazi, Libya, on the 11th of September 2012 (the 11th anniversary of the September 11th attacks). These attacks were carried out by an al-Qaeda affiliate called Ansar al-Sharia and resulted in the deaths of the American ambassador to Libya, Christopher Stevens, _**who became the first American ambassador to die in the line of duty in more than three decades**_ - along with three additional American security/foreign service personnel.

**This political assassination made my blood boil**. During my six years hunting terrorists in Africa, targeted political killings like the ones that took place in Benghazi reminded me - even in the worst of times - that our freedom isn't free at all. _**We have to fight for it**_.

| [**HELP ME FIGHT FOR _YOU_
MAKE A GIFT TODAY ** **› › **](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/59229642:sLNVZuHN9:m:1:2247059263:810B439607065EB100F8483C28AF527E:r)
---

Depending on who you ask, the Benghazi attack was either a random attack or a pre-meditated campaign of murder. But the fact of the matter is this: An American ambassador was killed in the line of duty and politicians pointed fingers at each other over who was responsible. That BS is the reason **[I'm running for Congress, and today I'm asking if you'll chip-in $5 or $10 to help me get my campaign off the ground.](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/59229642:sLNVZuHN9:m:1:2247059263:810B439607065EB100F8483C28AF527E:r) **

Hey friends.
A teacher friend of mine—hi, Scott!—told me the other day about an exercise he ran with his students. I wanted to share it with you, because it encapsulates one of the main reasons I’m in this race, as well as why where we currently are as a country should terrify all of us.
In the exercise Scott did with his students, he asked them **what kind of government 100 people stranded on an island would form**. Then this exchange occurred (I'm paraphrasing, of course):
STUDENT: What year does this take place?
TEACHER: Why do you ask? The year shouldn't really matter for this exercise.
STUDENT: **_I don't think people today would be able to get along long enough to form a government._**
Gutting, right? In a literal (though hypothetical) survival situation, they can’t envision a scenario where people would put aside their differences to live. Does not bode well for a country—or for that matter a planet—managing to survive.
I believe, and clearly students everywhere do too, that we are at a crisis moment of polarization. From the very beginning, this campaign has sought to address that crisis by doing things differently, **because we really are all stranded together on this earth with rising fascism and a climate crisis rapidly engulfing us.**
[**Will you chip in a buck or two (hum that jingle with me!) and help us spread a little love, a little hope, and a few jokes to lighten the mood and bring down the temperature to where we can actually just talk to one another?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/39117830/318481506/-847830488?refcode=fl_email_fr_20211129polarization_EG_main_SLA_l1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMGY2MzM2Zi0zMDUxLWVjMTEtOTgyMC1jODk2NjUzYjI2YzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NzGOG7jwBHjHu4Us1eGtiNIS_e_Ot_KFp5i8H6gKT0I=)

1. There are Republicans that I wish would stand up for the safety of our union (*cough* Scott Franklin), but they instead rely solely on conspiracy theories, lies, and dog-whistling to hold power at any cost.
2. The richest and most powerful actors in our society—Facebook’s monopoly foremost among them—are knowingly pouring resources to incentivize the spread of the most salacious, heated rhetoric to further divide us.
3. Making all of this ten times worse is the fact that we are still navigating a global pandemic. Because we had to physically separate for our safety, COVID-19 pushed us even further online, making those echo chambers (see point #2) even further isolated and disconnected from other perspectives.
4. FINALLY, we are still fighting for our basic rights and needs, and trying to save our democracy and the planet before it’s too late.

So, as you’ve probably noticed, this campaign may sound a little different. I may not use every catchphrase you wanna hear, and I may come up with a few of my own (bet on it, actually)! But this campaign is not about me—**it is truly about us.**
When I say “us” I don’t just mean progressive Democrats. I don’t just mean Democrats. The reality is that, in order to enact progress, we need to be challenged, regularly and without vitriol or nastiness. I mean folks who want a better life and who—whether they realize it or not—will choose love and solidarity over division and hatred. I’m in this thing because I really do believe that most people will choose love and solidarity. Otherwise, what would be the point?

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: Standing up for each other
body:
Standing up for each other

Hello
Peter,
I have
some great news to share with you today. There is a Supreme Court
case being heard in the next few days that has the potential to
overturn one of the most destructive rulings of all time - Roe v.
Wade. The case is Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health Organization.
What a
tremendous victory that would be for the thousands of lives it
would save! It is so important that the American Cornerstone
Institute submitted an Amicus Curiae Brief to the Supreme Court
to strengthen the position for life.
But this
one action will not be enough-we need to come together as a
united community. We need to push back against the liberal media
that tries to divide our movement.
One way
we can do that is by sharing our beliefs with the world. To help
you do that, we've created a few social media posts that you can
edit into your own voice and share with your community. Just
click on the icons below to get started.

That is
the power of Community. We can rally together to affect change on
a drastic level.
I also
wanted to encourage you to stand with ACI and myself tomorrow on
Giving Tuesday. We are taking bold steps to combat the
progressive agenda that wants to end life for the pre-born,
slowly strip away our Constitutional rights, and indoctrinate our
schoolchildren to grow up hating America.
There is
a solution, but it requires all of us. Not an individual, but a
community of supporters. I can think of no better time to stand
together than on Giving Tuesday tomorrow.
I'll be
sending you more information tomorrow but, if you want to get a
jump on your giving, you can make a donation here.
I hope
you'll continue to stand with us.

Sincerely,
Ben
Carson

--
Dr. Ben
Carson
Founder
and Chairman
American
Cornerstone Institute

body:
This is an important moment for our campaign, and we cannot let this opportunity go to waste as we fight to beat the odds and flip Wisconsin’s U.S. Senate seat blue. I know you're busy today, but I was hoping to get a quick moment of your time before the day gets away from us to chat about a brand-new poll in our race and the deadline that’s coming up tomorrow night. I would greatly appreciate it.

Our momentum is surging after a top-rated _FiveThirtyEight_ pollster released a new poll that shows our campaign beating Ron Johnson by two points. I’m the only Democrat polling ahead of him right now, which puts our campaign in the best position to take him on next November.

The number of people who have stepped up to join our grassroots team since this survey came out has been incredible. This is an important moment for our campaign, and we cannot let this opportunity go to waste as we fight to beat the odds and flip Wisconsin’s U.S. Senate seat blue. But we also can’t get too comfortable.

Outside groups are going to pour millions of dollars into this race to protect Ron Johnson. The guy has a major cash-on-hand advantage, Donald Trump’s full endorsement, and Mitch McConnell’s special interest network behind him. As the only Democrat beating him in this latest poll, I have a target on my back.

That’s why my team and I are pushing so hard ahead of tomorrow’s fundraising deadline. Folks,

We have so much more to do for the American people.

| [](https://links.e.leahyforvermont.) Friend, In 2016, my friend (and New Hampshire neighbor) Senator Maggie Hassan was elected by 1,017 votes. It was one of the closest races in New England history. My first two races were each decided by only a few thousand votes, so I know how important early support is for vulnerable incumbents, like Senator Hassan who is up for reelection in 2022. The stakes are high. Democrats are only holding onto a Senate majority by the thinnest of margins. Already, Mitch McConnell and his dark money allies have started flooding New Hampshire with millions in vicious attack ads. **To put it plainly, they 're going to continue to do everything in their power to try to turn this seat red -- and the whole Senate with it. We simply can't let that happen. ** **[Before the official end-of-month deadline tomorrow at midnight, will you contribute toward Senator Hassan's reelection campaign, so we can keep the Senate blue and continue fighting for progress? ](https://links.e.leahyforvermont.)** _If you 've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately_ | | [**$10 »**](https://links.e.leahyforvermont.)

I likely don't have to remind you how high the stakes are for our country at this moment in history. With _Roe v. Wade_ increasingly at risk, a worsening climate crisis, and an economy still reeling from an ongoing pandemic, we simply _must_ maintain control of the Senate.
Since President Biden took office, we've only begun to undo the harm wrought by the Trump administration and his enablers in a Republican-controlled Senate. And to be frank, we continue to be fighting an uphill battle against a minority party that has double downed on their commitment to destructive obstructionism.
We have so much more to do for the American people, and we can only do it if we keep Senator Hassan's seat blue. In 2020, both chambers of New Hampshire's state legislature flipped red. We can't let Senator Hassan's seat be next -- we have to act now.
**I fought hard to help Senator Hassan win in 2016, and I am going to do the same to help her win in 2022. Together, let 's make sure Maggie's campaign is strong enough to withstand the onslaught the Republican Party is already throwing at it. [Please, before tomorrow night's end-of-month deadline, donate toward Senator Hassan's reelection campaign.](https://links.e.leahyforvermont.)**
Thank you for all your work to keep the Senate blue.

name: Dustin Rhodes, Campaign Manager
subject: Former Trump Official, Secretary Of The Interior David Bernhardt Endorses Tiffany Shedd For Arizona Attorney General
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Shedd for Attorney General
body:
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
November 29, 2021
Contact: dustin@sheddforaz.com

Former Trump Official, Secretary Of The Interior David Bernhardt Endorses
Tiffany Shedd For Arizona Attorney General

ELOY, AZ – David Bernhardt, who served as the 53rd United States Secretary of
the Interior under President Trump, endorsed Tiffany Shedd’s campaign for
Attorney General today.

“Arizona needs an Attorney General who will put Arizona first just like
President Trump put America first,”said Bernhardt. “I am endorsing Tiffany
Shedd because I know she has what it takes to beat the radical activists and
bureaucrats in Washington D.C. and be a powerful voice for market based natural
resource solutions that are vital to Arizona’s economic future.”

“Tiffany is not only an accomplished attorney with over twenty-seven years of
experience, she also has a deeply personal understanding of land and water
issues as a farmer, hunter, and small business owner. I strongly encourage all
my fellow conservatives to join me in uniting behind her campaign.”

“Secretary Bernhardt has always been a terrific advocate for Arizona’s natural
resource industry and for stewardship of our lands. I am honored to have his
endorsement,”said Shedd. “As Secretary of the Interior, he stood up to the
bureaucrats in Washington who don’t understand the issues facing our western
states and seek to dictate how we live our lives. As Attorney General, I’m
going to go to work everyday and put Arizonans and our interests first just
like Secretary Bernhardt and President Trump.”

###

Tiffany Shedd grew up in Pinal County, and worked her way through college and
law school at the University of Arizona. A natural resource attorney and small
business owner, Tiffany has also worked as a bilingual kindergarten teacher and
farmer. She is a proud Republican Party Precinct Committeeman, homeschool mom,
small business owner, and NRA and 4-H certified shotgun and pistol coach.
Tiffany is honored to have been endorsed by President Donald J. Trump during
her campaign for Congress in 2020. Tiffany resides in Eloy, AZ with her
husband Rodney and their three children who are members of the Muscogee Creek
Nation.

Tiffany has also been endorsed by other conservative leaders and groups
including:

* Maggie’s List
* Senator Sonny Borrelli
* Representative Quang Nguyen
* Gila County Supervisor Woody Cline
* Gila County Supervisor Tim Humphrey
* Pinal County Supervisor Jeff Serdy
* Pinal County Supervisor Stephen Miller
* Pinal County Constable Ted Gremmel
* Casa Grande Mayor Craig McFarland
* Dewey-Humboldt Mayor John Hughes
* Prescott Mayor-Elect Phil Goode
* John Ladd, Border Rancher
* Dan Bell, Border Rancher
* Peggy Davis, Border Rancher
* Steve Boice, Border Rancher
* Gary Thrasher, Border Rancher

...BECAUSE our media is so corrupt

[ ](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0012GLHenLV8NFMLCo795GgwN6vtRlExzObmJNkRUxv7AKhjbazv5YlPztgPltzyGnjzVwrY1QCt_j58_ywM45YfWTakUO6DtIaEsv7Rdnz23mbiHIM99S9L8z2IeX4EVbnydYyeCFe64x_Z5_cCeRc2qPttDDNVHpczwaMtPA9kZRoG_XNAbDz7t8fPQ-EwVh1&c=QQLzfu36R53F9pXiTeIJw75dCMYwKJFI_x_qLjHvpdAqYpJNrXHcpQ==&ch=1-_SdNNlMjsRpCdGioL1BWi7QIddgJ2a9tWZaG74uqgSVGxDmCTyRw==)

| Peter,

| Like many of you, I learned A LOT about Kyle Rittenhouse over the past few weeks. If our media wasn't so corrupt, I might have known some of these key facts:
1\. I didn't know that Kyle put out a dumpster fire that was being rolled down to a gas station to blow up, with people all around.
2. I didn't know that Kyle's Dad, Grandma, and friends all lived in Kenosha, 20 minutes from where he resided with his Mom part-time in Illinois.
3. I didn't know that Joseph Rosenbaum knocked him down twice and then attempted to kick him with lethal force to the head.
4. I didn't know that Huber had hit him in the head twice with a skateboard.
5. I didn't know that Gaige Grosskreutz, a felon in possession of a firearm, aimed his gun at Kyle first, as he admitted on the stand.
6. I didn't know that in Wisconsin, it is legal for Kyle to have a gun, even at 17 (which was why the gun charge was dismissed).
7. I didn't know that Kyle did not cross state lines with a gun he wasn't supposed to have. The rightful gun owner did, as he was legally permitted to do.
8. I didn't know that Rosenbaum was a 5-time convicted child rapist and that Huber was a 2-time convicted woman beater. I didn't know that Grosskreutz was a convicted burglar with an assault on his record also.
9\. I didn't know that those Kyle shot were WHITE! In a sane society, this wouldn't matter. But in today's society where Democrats pimp out black folks regularly to create division ALL THE TIME, it matters. Again, no Black people were harmed or shot in this case.
The media has shown they will blatantly lie to us about anything that doesn't fit their narrative. It's because of THEIR LIES that riots broke out in Kenosha. And THEIR LIES caused Kyle to be treated so unfairly.
If you want to join me in standing up to the corrupt mainstream media, I hope you'll join my campaign and chip in a donation.

* **$80 billion** for the IRS to hire enough tax agents to fill Lambeau Field.

* **$8 billion** to create a Civilian Climate Corps larger than the Marine Corps.

Fellow American,

Since launching this campaign for Florida’s 9th Congressional District, I’ve been overjoyed with the continued support. Thank you for believing in my campaign and my mission to be the voice of the people.

As a Hispanic conservative, I have a unique perspective to share when it comes to our freedoms, border security, and the American Dream. And I look forward to sharing that perspective in Washington come November 2022.

I was born in New Orleans but raised by a strong, single mother in Honduras. As a young child, I saw firsthand the corruption and failure of big government in Central America.

Seeing how the current Democrat incumbent is nothing more than a socialist agenda pusher and Nancy Pelosi puppet is infuriating. _We don’t need someone who is okay with the status quo - we need someone who will shake up the status quo._

Campaigning is a tough job. It’s a seven-days-a-week, all-hands-on-deck effort and it includes having to ask committed conservatives like you, Fellow American, for your support. **You see, tomorrow I have a critical end-of-month fundraising deadline and I need your help to knock it out of the park.**

[**Will you chip in $5 or $10 so we can take on the radical Left, take back America from their socialist grasp, and help me meet my end-of-month fundraising goal?**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=00c65df7d956433d88c4c29ac7228dfe&_e=tpvHfQP2UCxLX23dB_BPJPKGSmsdN_XvRdJkDjS33v3D7rUC5mFcc0aJaPFu1Hm0vG_gPoNWzW__FqkFhV3svQ9g__OiI_DDnEULVCbUMBsRYdZWkwjqd-KYX2kq3p3FHfUn0EUBNHOzYtWTn_KHeoNTLverJcepZBQnns-YJI1ofzEn7I3ucxXcYRHutIVg3pKTyAMO5pWHQF8uez0u4ZnTzRQgNFJRdzsFkaQQEF7WglXkcKj0MhqOZHdirUjs0eq7Hni0yoFqWKvQxzY-0gwxUoEHbakEl5YZm1JgscEMWHSnuFTEs8Y7gXnc0uzFfLvJHzlA8K9vX9FSd_Z-M1J98EfJT3I0pJiTtZQOpd_gAuhLSOn2UNyQYB-VG3DuMaqV1F1sKWCxj3yQLPUM1R8JS4V_5C9zEWIb6C4iITy1afyx1xwWEW_3TJAM62U3UTpw_7vLDMqpxeUtJpgg0w%3D%3D)

name: Nick Rathod, Beto for Texas
subject: re: state of this race
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Beto for Texas
body:
This campaign is powered by grassroots donors like you chipping in whatever they can, as often as they can.
#
**Our first end-of-month deadline since Beto announced our run for governor is quickly approaching tomorrow at midnight** , and I wanted to take this opportunity to reach out about the state of this race.
Here's the bad news: Before Beto jumped in this race, Greg Abbott was building his fundraising machine. He already has a $55 million war chest thanks to his special interest mega-donors, and in competitive races like ours, the candidate who spends the most usually wins.
But here's the good news: This people-powered movement is up to the task! After we emailed yesterday, $5, $10, and $25 donations flowed in from across Texas. **Now, we need to keep up this momentum so we can hit our $200,000 November fundraising goal by midnight tomorrow.**
[Can we count on you to chip in $3 or more immediately? This campaign is powered by grassroots donors like you chipping in whatever they can, as often as they can.](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/50240?refcode=ema20211129-164701&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=164701%2E444211%2ES8YwW-)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/50240?refcode=ema20211129-164701&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=164701%2E444211%2ES8YwW-)**
This race is shaping up to be one of the most competitive — and expensive — in 2022. But while Abbott calls up his large corporate donors for check after check, we'll be focused on the people of Texas.
**To win, we're going to build the biggest and best organizing program Texas has ever seen.** That means visiting all 254 counties, knocking on every door in every neighborhood, and talking to everyone — Democrats, Republicans, Independents, and first-time voters.
Beto is focused on building a big, bold vision for Texas that encompasses everyone, _but we need this grassroots movement to have his back._
[Will you donate $3 to power our organizing and elect Beto? He's our best bet to flip Texas blue, so your support ahead of tomorrow's deadline brings us one step closer to defeating Abbott.](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/50240?refcode=ema20211129-164701&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=164701%2E444211%2ES8YwW-)
Thank you.
Nick Rathod

I hope you have been enjoying the This Is Living Podcast, because we sure have enjoyed pulling back the curtain on our busy lives. Our hope is that you feel encouraged and uplifted after each episode, wherever you are on your journey - single, married, parents of young or old, and beyond!

In this week's episode, we are bringing you a best-of compilation of the first several episodes from This Is Living. My life as a U.S. Senator and Erin's life as a Supreme Court attorney can lead to a fair share of busyness, but we want to encourage you that life can be full and meaningful despite the rigors of everyday life, so don’t settle for less!

Peter,
I’m writing today to share my deepest appreciation for all of our nation’s veterans. Growing up on army bases and in a family full of veterans, I learned discipline very early on and that service is meant to be selfless.
Today, we want to honor members of the Armed Forces that have defended our nation’s freedom and protected our country's future.
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/88943/images/Image%20from%20iOS%20%2851%29.jpg]Today also reminds us that we must do more to protect our veterans when they re-enter civilian life. After returning home many veterans are not given adequate support. GA-14 has a considerable veteran population yet we only have one VA hospital in the district and no veterans’ cemeteries . We must do better. We will do better. That's why I'm running to change the way that we treat our veterans when they return home.
We owe a debt to those who’ve placed their lives on the line to protect our freedom as Americans, and we have to do better to provide for their care and to honor their sacrifices.
Sincerely,
Holly McCormack.

Friend,
**DEADLINE APPROACHING!**

Liz Cheney has built a war chest off of wealthy DC insiders and establishment elitists. Our campaign, in contrast, is fueled by the patriots of the America First movement. If we want to take our country back, I need your support today.

Putting America and Wyoming First is my top priority. We need a government that gets out of the way of families and businesses. One that respects the power of the people, and is accountable to us. We need representatives who serve the needs of their constituents. I’m deeply grateful for every grassroots donor who chips in to help power our movement — because funding our campaign from the grassroots level makes a powerfully important difference. Over time, a democracy with political campaigns funded by a small number of people who can contribute a lot of money looks very different from a democracy with campaigns funded by a large number of people who chip in a little at a time. It’s the difference between a government that works great for those at the top and a government that can work for everyone. With a grassroots-funded movement, we can fight back against powerful interests like the gun lobby, Big Pharma, and fossil fuel giants who've used their deep pockets to block change. And every month, we set fundraising goals to show that grassroots donors like you are still in this fight. clean_body: I’m deeply grateful for every grassroots donor who chips in to help power our movement — because funding our campaign from the grassroots level makes a powerfully important difference. | | | I’m deeply grateful for every grassroots donor who chips in to help power our movement — because funding our campaign from the grassroots level makes a powerfully important difference. Over time, a democracy with political campaigns funded by a small number of people who can contribute a lot of money looks very different from a democracy with campaigns funded by a large number of people who chip in a little at a time. It’s the difference between a government that works great for those at the top and a government that can work for everyone. With a grassroots-funded movement, we can fight back against powerful interests like the gun lobby, Big Pharma, and fossil fuel giants who've used their deep pockets to block change. And every month, we set fundraising goals to show that grassroots donors like you are still in this fight. = | If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically: | | | | | | | | | | | In the last election cycle, grassroots donors raised record amounts of money to flip the Senate and White House. Now, our toes are on the line to make big, structural change — to loosen the stranglehold of big money on our democracy. But we have to keep up the fight. We need to defend and expand our razor-thin majorities in 2022 — because everything we’re working on in Washington right now would be a whole lot easier if we had more Democrats in office. body:
The gun lobby is on a dangerous campaign to roll back decades of gun violence prevention laws.
#

Friends,
Gabby reached out to you yesterday about Giffords’ Giving Tuesday fundraising drive. Now I’m reaching out to ask you to donate because this is incredibly important.
I joined Giffords as a Senior Policy Advisor to be part of the fight to save lives and ensure gun ownership is safe and responsible. Before that, I worked at the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms, and Explosives (ATF) for 25 years, and served on the Firearms Committee for the International Association of Chiefs of Police for two terms. So I know firsthand how important this fight against the gun lobby really is.
Right now, lives truly hang in the balance. The gun lobby is on an unhinged campaign to roll back decades of gun safety legislation and put guns in the hands of as many people as possible—just to line their pockets.
[**Please, make a $3 donation to our Giving Tuesday fundraising drive before tomorrow at midnight. Your support means the world to this team and makes a real difference in the fight to end gun violence.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/giffords-em-nov21-eom?refcode=em211129-1-15&t=1&refcode2=1251_3935704_ztuTEI&akid=1251%2E3935704%2EztuTEI)

I believe Congress has a responsibility to act to keep us safe from irresponsible gun owners and sellers. Some people accuse me of being “anti-Second Amendment” because of that sentiment, but they’re wrong. I don’t apologize because responsible gun owners like me know that the Second Amendment and commonsense gun safety measures go hand-in-hand. Lawmakers must make it harder for people who shouldn't have guns—like domestic abusers—to get their hands on deadly firearms.
That’s why we’re doing the work to get universal background checks signed into law, hold the NRA accountable for their illegal campaign contributions, and make sure that the Supreme Court does not rule in the gun lobby’s favor to make guns more accessible to the wrong people.

This is really exciting news. Are you ready to hear it? Turning Point USA is beyond thrilled to announce a brand new event: Amer

Turning Point USA is beyond thrilled to announce a _brand new event:_**AmericaFest 2021!** This four-day event will be _the largest conservative movement event in the country_ —and an event like you’ve _never_ seen, featuring dozens of the best and brightest conservative speakers, special musical guests, and non-stop energy and excitement alongside _thousands of like-minded, freedom-loving individuals._ [**TPUSA wants to get thousands of young people to AmericaFest 2021—but we need your help to do it.******](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z8tr4icn6mqbo70j1mv41m2sutph0rrd7m8q9hp0_rp22sh2s8i66pj0s9h6coj4c9h2bs) You see, thousands of young conservatives are ready to come to AmericaFest, but, being full-time students with limited resources, they simply don’t have the means to afford the ticket. I’m hoping that as a fellow patriot who loves America and cares about the next generation, you’ll help us meet some of those needs. **Will you help us educate and encourage our future leaders to steer this country in the right direction by**[**making a generous gift right now to TPUSA’s AmericaFest Scholarship Fund**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zb2gtsko2o959kdo9i8vrv13vtkltk4d82edtje0_rp22sh2s8i66pj0s9h6coj4c9h2bs)**[?](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z3bpe6i9ti9mjb7c3b09vvlts0nhbnte90qoggp0_rp22sh2s8i66pj0s9h6coj4c9h2bs) ** [**A contribution of $35 will provide a One-Day Pass to this massive event for a conservative student. A generous gift of $100 will pay for an entire Four-Day Experience for a young conservative.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zdmtmpfu7be7f6o4cg216o3d9giv9dg105bj3ap8_rp22sh2s8i66pj0s9h6coj4c9h2bs)

---
This four day celebration of America, of our constitutional rights, and of our freedom is happening this _**December 18-21 in Phoenix, Arizona**_** _._ **If you will be in the Southwest, I hope you’ll consider joining us! And if you’re not able to make it, [**please consider sponsoring a student today**.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zl3lagsvns493i8ir1jj23mstlrruckqrsan8b6o_rp22sh2s8i66pj0s9h6coj4c9h2bs) **AmericaFest 2021** will be an event unlike any this movement has ever seen—by creating an experience that breaks the traditional norms of a political conference as we continue to****_bridge the gap between politics and entertainment to win America’s culture war._ Guest speakers include: Donald Trump Jr. Senator Ted Cruz Tucker Carlson Candace Owens **And Many More!** Plus, full live concerts by: Dustin Lynch Brantley Gilbert RaeLynn Russell Dickerson **And More Musical Guests!** Plus entertainment, food, and presentations from dozens of conservative organizations. This event will go down in the history books as one of the greatest conservative events in the USA! But to make sure we can execute it to its fullest potential, we need __YOUR__ help to get as many young conservatives in the door as possible. [**Will you please help us do that with a generous Scholarship Contribution of $35, or even $100 today?**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zgu1ogls482ma7eb3shht9j6pg7rke4c3llitmlo_rp22sh2s8i66pj0s9h6coj4c9h2bs)
---
[**Give One-Day Pass**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zs8adj61il38kj7o97rrmpsankbs9vmohcithi38_rp22sh2s8i66pj0s9h6coj4c9h2bs)
---
[**Give Four-Day Experience**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z76o77oraj50m2jgbmo3rglkf9ff2vgaa8m2ktb0_rp22sh2s8i66pj0s9h6coj4c9h2bs)
---
[**Give Another Amount**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z0ao9655chsh757v8kesvn62acithjvo4v9sp7po_rp22sh2s8i66pj0s9h6coj4c9h2bs)
---
I personally know many of our great guest speakers and musical guests very well. Each of them have personally told me they cannot wait to attend this incredible event! All have been working tirelessly to prepare for **AmericaFest 2021** and have promised not to disappoint! _It’s going to be awesome._ Building up this nation and empowering students through education is my life’s work. This event is a culmination of everything I have spent the last decade focusing on— _and so much more._ If you’re able, I hope you’ll join us **December 18-21 in Phoenix, Arizona** —[**and please consider sponsoring one or more students so they can attend this mind-opening, liberty-loving, informing and entertaining experience!**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zlr9oc4m0qhq9d4ou8k3thttuopkvvcqsoo5dvb8_rp22sh2s8i66pj0s9h6coj4c9h2bs)

With unbridled excitement, Charlie Kirk Founder, President Turning Point USA

body:
Turning Point USA is beyond thrilled to announce a brand new event: AmericaFest 2021! This four-day event will be the largest co
_Sponsored message_
| | | [](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zgq7vbl97giug0rl08cal15aj44k9vjc3idel960_rp22sh2s8i66pj0s9h6ao34sph2bs)

| [](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zfs9b8pjg5auhqk8dcoki1bm37v15lv99nqb5rvo_rp22sh2s8i66pj0s9h6ao34sph2bs) Hi Fellow American, This is really exciting news. Are you ready to hear it? Turning Point USA is beyond thrilled to announce a _brand new event:_**AmericaFest 2021!** This four-day event will be _the largest conservative movement event in the country_ —and an event like you’ve _never_ seen, featuring dozens of the best and brightest conservative speakers, special musical guests, and non-stop energy and excitement alongside _thousands of like-minded, freedom-loving individuals._ [**TPUSA wants to get thousands of young people to AmericaFest 2021—but we need your help to do it.******](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zu67acfj92m1l3en254qra9dfnpq0a61ik1fd7p0_rp22sh2s8i66pj0s9h6ao34sph2bs) You see, thousands of young conservatives are ready to come to AmericaFest, but, being full-time students with limited resources, they simply don’t have the means to afford the ticket. I’m hoping that as a fellow patriot who loves America and cares about the next generation, you’ll help us meet some of those needs. **Will you help us educate and encourage our future leaders to steer this country in the right direction by**[**making a generous gift right now to TPUSA’s AmericaFest Scholarship Fund**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zvfdhclaf18q81519d0vbkac0et8e4ffokjr9rho_rp22sh2s8i66pj0s9h6ao34sph2bs)**[?](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z22l59mquldp6nk7mkc1jfekchdk5nrg7n5947a0_rp22sh2s8i66pj0s9h6ao34sph2bs) ** [**A contribution of $35 will provide a One-Day Pass to this massive event for a conservative student. A generous gift of $100 will pay for an entire Four-Day Experience for a young conservative.**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zhcfdqtg6751gotjpk7u5j1bd3mpgugu2s7cmem0_rp22sh2s8i66pj0s9h6ao34sph2bs)
---
[**Give Gift!**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zhmnvd5nhb9bhnb3c6vgikt362t59q5sm1u40nu8_rp22sh2s8i66pj0s9h6ao34sph2bs)
---
This four day celebration of America, of our constitutional rights, and of our freedom is happening this _**December 18-21 in Phoenix, Arizona**_** _._ **If you will be in the Southwest, I hope you’ll consider joining us! And if you’re not able to make it, [**please consider sponsoring a student today**.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zvvpvas5j1k06g7pbdp9l6j0eptv86rub7agb698_rp22sh2s8i66pj0s9h6ao34sph2bs) **AmericaFest 2021** will be an event unlike any this movement has ever seen—by creating an experience that breaks the traditional norms of a political conference as we continue to****_bridge the gap between politics and entertainment to win America’s culture war._ Guest speakers include: Donald Trump Jr. Senator Ted Cruz Tucker Carlson Candace Owens **And Many More!** Plus, full live concerts by: Dustin Lynch Brantley Gilbert RaeLynn Russell Dickerson **And More Musical Guests!** Plus entertainment, food, and presentations from dozens of conservative organizations. This event will go down in the history books as one of the greatest conservative events in the USA! But to make sure we can execute it to its fullest potential, we need __YOUR__ help to get as many young conservatives in the door as possible. [**Will you please help us do that with a generous Scholarship Contribution of $35, or even $100 today?**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zotha8bh167ep1r47masbbqu1ur538jloq56mfqg_rp22sh2s8i66pj0s9h6ao34sph2bs)
---
[**Give One-Day Pass**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zm8k4qbgjui5ilh0gqh4j10lnunmmbfq9d4j45c8_rp22sh2s8i66pj0s9h6ao34sph2bs)
---
[**Give Four-Day Experience**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zbm8k8m61e2faqirrlkdguuetl829mp59hu0p380_rp22sh2s8i66pj0s9h6ao34sph2bs)
---
[**Give Another Amount**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zj0r386h02m0sgpb9ntqebc7brp04kc6p5j4m7d8_rp22sh2s8i66pj0s9h6ao34sph2bs)
---
I personally know many of our great guest speakers and musical guests very well. Each of them have personally told me they cannot wait to attend this incredible event! All have been working tirelessly to prepare for **AmericaFest 2021** and have promised not to disappoint! _It’s going to be awesome._ Building up this nation and empowering students through education is my life’s work. This event is a culmination of everything I have spent the last decade focusing on— _and so much more._ If you’re able, I hope you’ll join us **December 18-21 in Phoenix, Arizona** —[**and please consider sponsoring one or more students so they can attend this mind-opening, liberty-loving, informing and entertaining experience!**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z35i6a3l3ujono36sj0e3e7uol1jgdlfo8t53a98_rp22sh2s8i66pj0s9h6ao34sph2bs)
---
With unbridled excitement, Charlie Kirk Founder, President Turning Point USA

| | **The debt ceiling needs to be eliminated.** Politicians have been weaponizing the debt ceiling as long as it has existed, and it is wrong. This has been especially true in the time after Donald Trump's presidency, where we saw tax cuts for the wealthiest Americans that piled up debt—and then that same debt used as a reason to deny assistance to our most vulnerable communities. Yes. After all, once Congress accrues debt—good, bad, or otherwise—it is Congress's responsibility to make the payments on the debt. Consider this: If your family racked up debt and then refused to make the payments on that debt, what would happen? Your assets would be seized and you would be forced into bankruptcy. **America will not declare bankruptcy. So it is time to end the political games around the debt ceiling.** I want us to be the coalition that _finally_ brings common sense and urgency to this discussion. We need to do what is best for America and show the world that we will protect the full faith and credit of the United States of America. body:
Hello Patriot,

On Saturday, December 11, Joe will be hosting a Town Hall event in Vancouver with Chris Rufo, and we’re happy to invite you!

Chris Rufo is best known for bringing national attention to the divisive, anti-American Critical Race Theory taught in public schools. Thanks to his efforts, parents across the country are standing up at school board meetings and demanding that this toxic curriculum that teaches children to hate America be banned.

Chris’s influence also led to the Trump administration’s ban on government agencies and contractors that force CRT on their employees.

We will have a private reception at 2:30 PM where you will get the chance to talk directly with Chris and get a photo with Chris and Joe. We will serve light refreshments. Tickets start at $125.

The town hall that follows at 3:30 is open to all. However, you must RSVP.

To RSVP for the town hall or buy tickets for the private reception, visit https://www.joekentforcongress.com/rufo

See you there!

Byron Sanford
Campaign Manager
Joe Kent for Congress

PS: The event with Chris Rufo is in Vancouver on Saturday, December 11. But if you can't make it, you can still help out the campaign by making a contribution at https://www.joekentforcongress.com. Thanks!

name: Richard Blumenthal
subject: Can't take anything for granted
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blumenthal for Connecticut
body:
[ ](http://salsa4.salsalabs.com/dia/track.jsp?v=2&c=sj%2BaWuy3%2BlLiaolYOWFLw3d208vsQ1Ot&url=http%3A%2F%2Frichardblumenthal.com%2F)
Friend,
I'm writing to you after a call with my fundraising team. Unfortunately, we are looking at a very troubling shortfall this month - and we're running out of time to turn things around before Tuesday's end-of-month deadline.
Forgive my concern, but I can't help but be worried with the Senate split 50-50. We're holding on to control of the chamber by a single thread. Republicans just notched an upset victory in Virginia's gubernatorial race and came within mere points of flipping New Jersey red, too. Simply put, we can't take any seat in any state for granted.
The only way we can protect and expand Democratic Senate control is by setting and hitting ambitious fundraising goals. If we don't come through, Senate control will fall back into the hands of Mitch McConnell.
So I have to ask you directly, Friend: If you've been waiting for the right moment to invest in this must-win Senate race, it's now. **[Please, will you donate now to keep this seat blue and protect Democratic control of the Senate?](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1098-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)**
I hope you'll allow me a moment to explain what's at stake.
Sadly, the Republican Party has transformed itself into an organism that is beholden to one thing only: the twice-impeached, disgraced former president, Donald Trump. Trump has a complete and total hold over the party - and their overwhelming submission to his will is why a Republican-controlled Senate is so dangerous. Right now, Republican members of Congress are being linked to aiding the violent insurrectionists that attacked our Capitol. Some are even openly praising those who attacked our democracy. Funds raised by the Republican National Committee are being spent openly to cover Donald Trump's legal fees!
Just as bad, Republicans are defending Donald Trump's attempts to weaponize the Department of Justice to overturn the election results.**The only way we are able to hold Trump and his accomplices accountable is by keeping control of the Senate. Derek — We’re less than 48 hours away from our end-of-month deadline, and I’m hoping you can spare me a moment so I can tell you why this deadline is so important. After the clock strikes midnight on Tuesday, there are exactly 31 days left to hit our end-of-year goal, raise the funds for my re-election, and help other Democratic campaigns end the year strong so we are prepared for the turbulent year ahead. With the midterms on the horizon, we cannot take a single race for granted. _We have a 5-seat margin in the House. And it’s a 50-50 Senate._ The GOP only needs to flip one seat in the Senate to reclaim the majority. **And the _Cook Political Report_ shifted three key Senate races in Republicans’ favor.** Our 5-seat majority in the House is the narrowest in decades, and Democrats lost seats in the House during the 2020 election despite President Biden’s win. But I believe it’s a fight we still can win. Why? Because of people like you. And because we don’t have a choice. We have to win. It’s crucial that we defend our majority and preserve our democracy. And maybe, just maybe, we can do even better and win back a few seats. **Losing the House or Senate to the GOP would be a disaster.** Without the Democratic majority you sent to Congress, the _American Rescue Plan Act_ would have never passed. The _Build Back Better Act_ would be dead on arrival. And we’d be stuck repeating Infrastructure Week, week after week, year after year, as Republicans fail to pass anything of substance. **Democrats deliver.** But here’s the bottom line: If we’re going to protect our democracy and keep Republicans from handing Donald Trump the 2024 election on a silver platter — we need to keep our majorities so Mitch McConnell and Kevin McCarthy don’t get anywhere near a majority. **Derek, will you pitch in right now to help us reach our end-of-month goal? Thanksgiving granted me an opportunity to spend time with my family and count my many blessings. One of those blessings are the countless Patriots volunteering for this effort who truly inspire me. A Patriot is someone who loves America and zealously supports and defends it. People who, despite being censored and suppressed, continue to promote the American Dream. My hope for our nation’s future has been ignited. In traveling across Idaho, I’ve been blessed to meet many modern-day heroes. These are extraordinary people who see a problem and jump in with both feet to solve it. They don’t let shifting winds dictate which way they go, and they don’t sit on the sidelines. They join the journey and add to the character of it. And despite the twists and turns they don’t complain or lose faith. They know that no one else is going to drop in to save us from the growing insanity, they commit to being a part of the change they wish to see. To everyone who spends hours getting the word out to their friends, family, and neighbors. To everyone who makes personal sacrifices for this campaign and this cause. I dedicate this campaign to you! It is my most solemn promise that I will continue to put everything on the line to win. This campaign is about more than politics as usual. It is our task to put principles over politics. If we accomplish that then Idaho will inspire and lead America.

body:
I'm in this race to expand my unlikely story of opportunity to more Americans.
| | |
---
Friend – as I close in on my most important fundraising deadline to date, I've never forgotten that the movement we're building is far bigger than me.
**I'm in this race to expand my unlikely story of opportunity to more Americans. **You see, there was nothing easy about growing up as a poor, Black girl in the South, the daughter of a maid and a janitor. name: Morgan Harper
subject: Marietta, OH
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Morgan Harper for Ohio
body:
This is why our November deadline is so critical.
# [](https://act.morganharper.org/go/1512?refcode=em20211129-420-footer-ak&t=2&akid=420%2E90090%2EfJulIw)
**This is how I spent my morning on Thanksgiving:**
[](https://act.morganharper.org/go/16461?t=3&akid=420%2E90090%2EfJulIw)
_Photo of me helping distribute meals featured in The Marietta Times —_[** _full article here._**](https://act.morganharper.org/go/16462?t=4&akid=420%2E90090%2EfJulIw)
[****](https://act.morganharper.org/go/16461?t=5&akid=420%2E90090%2EfJulIw)
**30% of folks in Marietta live in poverty****.** We need to support each other, especially on days like this. _Community is all we got_.
I’m constantly talking about how important community is, and I believe in the power of collective healing. My family and I leaned on our community when we were going through our toughest struggles, and to be honest, I don’t know where we’d be today if we didn’t have that support system.
During my trip, I saw just how many folks were in the Marietta community working hard and hoping to see it turn around. We can’t keep waiting for corporate politicians to fix our communities. We’ve got to lead that charge. **That’s why I’m humbly asking you today:[_Can you donate $5, $3, $2, or anything you can, to our campaign today so we can fight to build strong communities across Ohio? We need 700 contributions before tomorrow at midnight and we’re not there yet._](https://act.morganharper.org/go/16461?t=6&akid=420%2E90090%2EfJulIw) **
After I left Marietta, I got the sweetest message from a young person who lives in the community:
[](https://act.morganharper.org/go/16461?t=7&akid=420%2E90090%2EfJulIw)
**This is why I’m running****.** Communities like Marietta and my own childhood community have been ignored for far too long. Corporate-backed politicians ignore communities like ours in favor of lining their own pockets. We deserve real change and real progress, not empty promises. ****
**So let’s do this. Together with your help****, we can show these comfortable politicians that Ohio is ready for change.**[**_Can you donate anything you can to help us reach our goal of 700 contributions by midnight tomorrow?_**](https://act.morganharper.org/go/16461?t=8&akid=420%2E90090%2EfJulIw)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.morganharper.org/go/16468?refcode=em20211129-420&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=27&akid=420%2E90090%2EfJulIw)**
**The status quo won’t cut it anymore.**
Thank you for being a part of this team,
Morgan
[](https://act.morganharper.org/go/16461?t=28&akid=420%2E90090%2EfJulIw)
Morgan Harper for U.S. Senate in Ohio
**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mh-email?refcode=em20211129-420-footer&t=29&refcode2=420_90090_fJulIw&akid=420%2E90090%2EfJulIw)**

name: Team Tobias
subject: Chat with Bakari Sellers?
body:
Not that we're upset but we must have missed your RSVP for our virtual end-of-year gala.
---
| | Peter,

We must have missed your RSVP for our virtual end-of-year gala with **civil rights attorney and CNN commentator Bakari Sellers**. We’ll be virtual on December 9th at 6 p.m. PT talking about the key issues facing our state.

[**You’ll be there, right?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/39138235/318589118/-643211092?refcode=em1129&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzI2MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMmU0Y2U1Ny03NTUxLWVjMTEtOTgyMC1hMDg1ZmMzMWFjOTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XipR5zCJv_JxoT26FudWaPvNhU1x-_LDByL8rITvntg=) [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/39138237/318589121/-643211092?refcode=em1129&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzI2MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMmU0Y2U1Ny03NTUxLWVjMTEtOTgyMC1hMDg1ZmMzMWFjOTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XipR5zCJv_JxoT26FudWaPvNhU1x-_LDByL8rITvntg=)
**This is not an event you want to miss!** Bakari Sellers is one of the keenest political analysts in the nation. At 22, Bakari was the youngest African American ever to hold office in the South Carolina House of Representatives from 2006-2014. He is a political commentator on CNN, and recently published a new memoir book titled _My Vanishing Country_ which serves as an introspective look at working-class African American families in the rural South. He joined us last year for a conversation on race and we’re excited to have him join us again as we head into next year’s primary season.

[**Don’t forget to RSVP here.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/39138238/318589123/-643211092?refcode=em1129&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzI2MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMmU0Y2U1Ny03NTUxLWVjMTEtOTgyMC1hMDg1ZmMzMWFjOTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XipR5zCJv_JxoT26FudWaPvNhU1x-_LDByL8rITvntg=)

Thank you and hope to see you on the 9th,

Team Tobias

At 22, Bakari was the youngest African American ever to hold office in the South Carolina House of Representatives from 2006-2014.
