body:
Governor Whitmer’s attempts to relax election security will only encourage more cheating, and further erode trust in the election process. | | | |
---
| | |
## Only 26 percent of voters think the correct person won each of the last two Presidential elections.
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
| Twenty-six percent? That’s an alarming statistic, Peter!

The numbers come from Rassmussen polling:
* 52 percent of Democrats and 20 percent of Independents believe Trump did not legitimately win in 2016
* 66 percent of Republicans and 25 percent of Independents believe Biden did not legitimately win in 2020.

For the past five years, **Democrats like Gretchen Whitmer and Nancy Pelosi have been doing everything in their power to undermine election security** — whether it was lying about President Trump and phony “Russian collusion” or changing election laws to make it easier for cheating to occur

**Why else would Whitmer veto sensible election security bills?**

And why would her administration be pushing to remove any security from absentee ballot requests?

_The Detroit News_ just ran a thorough article exposing the plan to allow absentee ballot requests without a valid signature. This is flat out wrong and flies in the face of existing state law.

Currently applicants for absentee ballots must sign their requests, and the signatures must be verified by election clerks. **The Whitmer/Benson plan would allow for absolute fraud by allowing online requests with zero verification**.

Following the serious questions of election security in the 2020 election, we should be doing everything possible to restore confidence and integrity to our election process.

This is what I’m fighting for, and what I’ll do as your next Governor.
1. **Strengthen voter ID laws. ** Currently, Michigan law requires an ID to vote, but voters are still allowed to cast a ballot without an ID by signing an affidavit. We must tighten this requirement. If someone tries to vote without a valid ID, their “provisional” ballot should be set aside until they can prove eligibility to vote. We require ID to apply for food stamps or welfare benefits, cash a check, purchase alcohol, board a plane, rent a car or hotel room, pick up a prescription or open a bank account, we certainly can require ID to vote.

2. **Audit the voter registration lists and clean them up.** Let’s make sure only those who are legally allowed to vote are on the voter list.

3. **Ban ballot harvesting** to assure voters – especially the elderly – are able to cast their ballot privately without any pressure, harassment or coercion.

4. **Verify the citizenship of voters** to make sure those who are living in our country, state and local communities illegally are not allowed to vote in our elections. Projections are that over 2 million will enter our country illegally this year thanks to the Biden administration’s lax policies. Many will end up in Michigan to join other illegal immigrants here already. We must ensure that only citizens are registered and allowed to cast ballots.

5. **Enhance procedures to allow election observers** complete, unimpeded access to the election process – both in casting votes and in counting them.

6. **Discontinue same-day voter registration.** We must give election officials sufficient time to verify that someone is legally able to cast a ballot before they vote. Currently, an individual without proper documentation is allowed to register and cast a “provisional” ballot on Election Day. Unless evidence can be found to dispute the eligibility of the person, their ballot is counted. We cannot continue to allow this.

7. **Block any and all attempts to allow universal mail-in balloting.** Michigan voters have the ability to vote by mail upon signed request. Ballots should never be mailed to people other than those who legally ask to be mailed a ballot.

Governor Whitmer’s attempts to relax election security will only encourage more cheating, and further erode trust in the election process.

**Peter, it’s time to Dump Whitmer. Are you with me?**

| Dear Patriot, Did you think Anthony Fauci was going to quietly fade into the sunset? I have bad news for you -- he's making a renewed push for even more power over your life. Fauci made two statements this week that have me worried sick about what he's planning to do next. _"They're really criticizing science because I represent science."_ That's a direct quote from Anthony Fauci this week -- an attack on liberty-loving conservatives like me who dare to question his decrees. For a public official like Fauci to have this much arrogance is dangerous, saying that he alone represents science and insulting anyone who opposes his heavy-handed lockdowns. That's right, I said lockdowns. Did you think those were a thing of the past? I have even more bad news -- lockdowns are back on the table for Anthony Fauci. This leads me to his second quote, perhaps his most disturbing one yet. You see, the media is spreading fear about the new "Omicron" variant of COVID. Fauci went on TV and said that the government is willing to do _"anything and everything"_ to restrict the freedoms of Americans, and that we all should _"prepare for the worst."_ And when asked specifically about a new round of lockdowns, Fauci left the door open, saying it is _"too soon to tell."_ The fight over authoritarian COVID policies is back, and it's about to reach a fever pitch. I've successfully pushed back against Fauci's worst schemes before. I am confident that I can do it again. But I can only do it if I continue serving as a U.S. Senator. And the Left knows that the best way to push through Fauci's new Omicron lockdowns is to remove me from my Senate seat. When Fauci says _"I represent science"_ and demands that his proclamations be obeyed, the Democratic Party is always there to enforce his decrees. And with a 50-50 tie in the U.S. Senate, you and I cannot give an inch -- or else Fauci's wildest authoritarian dreams will soon become law. I need your help so that I can stay in this fight. [Will you chip in $100, $50, $25, or $10 right away so that Fauci doesn't get his way?](https://ct.klclick.com/f/a/89PdrZMuUoqTos7FgtuG3g~~/AASl5QA~/RgRjh8MeP0RbaHR0cDovL3NlY3VyZS5yYW5kcGF1bC5jb20vZG9uYXRlP19reD1QZE1aZjVOdGZBemI3REtTNmNnQUZMNnRJc2pjM1QzQzdsQ3haam1hNWpRJTNELkp6UmNVS1cDc3BjQgphjh4-pWGjucg7UhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAANj9w~~) As long as Fauci and his allies believe that the American people will put up with his draconian orders, they will never go away. And as Americans, you and I must ask ourselves what kind of society we want to build for the future. Should America be permanently masked up, locked down, and socially distanced? Or should patriotic Americans like you and I try to rebuild America for the next generation? This upcoming fight against Fauci will determine which path America takes. body:
This is an important update in Wisconsin’s U.S. Senate race. Can you give us a brief moment to show you some new polling results? This is an important update in Wisconsin’s U.S. Senate race. Please give us a brief moment to show you some recent polling results and explain what they mean for our chances in 2022.

**Ron Johnson is in serious trouble.** A recent poll from Marquette Law School revealed that only 38% of Wisconsin voters would re-elect him. 52% want “someone else.” This race is a major opening for Democrats to flip a Republican-held Senate seat.

name: Kevin Kiley
subject: Newsom Abdicates the Throne
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kevin Kiley for Assembly 2022 9458 Treelake Road, Granite Bay, CA 95746, United States
body:
|
---
Hi Peter, I've just published a new blog post: [Newsom's Abdication](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=Bjc8XUdeJ9yV6eR3mI9Z6HRd5urWv8u8i-Pa-jQziorSJshUj_jTMWmlfqcBmjHIi0i1qc6YSsYEb0GWWyRioA&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=nov_29_final&n=1) In our court battles against Newsom, he’s insisted a State of Emergency “centralizes the State’s powers in the hands of the Governor.” But happens if those hands are clutching a margarita south of the border? In that case, he abdicates the throne. With Newsom vacationing in Cabo this last week, the Lieutenant Governor took his place. Then yesterday, she also left California. The Senate President is third in the line of succession and assumed the governorship. So as we’re supposedly embroiled in a State of Emergency, both Newsom and the Lt. Governor abdicated all responsibility for any “emergency” response. If this isn’t a reason to pass ACR 46, my resolution to terminate the emergency, I don’t know what is. Alas, Newsom did return last night. He came back to see he’s successfully gotten a court to halt the vaccine mandate for his big union donor. At the same time, he remains the only governor imposing a mandate on kids. It’s hard to imagine anything more corrupt. What's more, a new study finds “striking evidence of declining overall cognitive functioning in children” from masks and other COVID measures. Ending the emergency will mean a return to normal schooling. It can’t wait another day. [Support Citizen-Backed Representation](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=09K6E4GvoPozZ73mzf50y5etLj1_9wCfyRoQ3wvVmv_IPFMzzv9WmdPghwMBSwX0JHWSzI75LyWvC6h1sivRLtVVWDof7SVZORZZbP1UPz4&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=nov_29_final&n=2) [Share This Post on Facebook](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=27Ax0UmWOX2J8J_QwK9Z6lpHI-UVcODcFSdMgu5zpAwHmeZsLyzx1fkDO1b5U6kylPiGQoB6nGwReA62XbKlmA&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=nov_29_final&n=3) Kevin Kiley

Peter, the Senate is officially back in session today, and there's a lot on their plate to get to before they leave town.

But we know that this legislation is already facing the same, special interest opposition from the corporate PACs, Big Pharma, Wall Street, and fossil fuel companies that tried just about anything to kill it in the House. We need to do everything we can to build the momentum necessary to get the Senate to act immediately — _so we can finally invest in our communities._
[**Peter, I know this has been a long fight, but we've come too far to let up now. That's why I'm asking: Can you chip in $3 or any amount you can afford to help us hit our end-of-month goal of $35,000 and ensure the Senate sends the Build Back Better Act to President Biden's desk ASAP?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/8961?refcode=em20211129-839&%3Bamounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=839%2E420207%2E--G_tS)

subject: We have to try something different.

body:
If Democrats are going to win this race, we have to try something different in North Carolina.
#

Friends -
If Democrats are going to win this race, we have to try something different in North Carolina. We need a candidate and campaign that can speak to the hopes and needs of our people if we are going to mobilize and excite the diverse coalition of voters required to win.
That’s exactly what I intend to do. As your next Senator, I will listen and fight for your family. When it comes to lowering health care and prescription drug costs, taking aggressive action on climate change, protecting voting rights, raising the minimum wage to $15 and more, I will be proud to vote Yes on behalf of all North Carolinians.
But this type of campaign will require us to build the largest people-powered movement our state has seen. So I’ve put my faith in this grassroots team.
It makes a true difference when each of us pitches in just a bit. Like earlier this month when a teacher from Greenville named Julie chipped in $20. Then Troy, a social worker from Raleigh, donated $100, and a grad student from Hillsborough named Mary started a new $10 recurring donation. Now they’re all counting on you to join them before tomorrow’s fundraising deadline.
**[Will you please make a $3 donation to our campaign today to help us lay the groundwork required to flip this seat for Democrats in 2022? Fellow American,

We have been working hard for several months to reach the voters of Texas with my winning message of strong, effective conservative leadership for our state. And last week I officially filed my candidacy for Governor with the office of the Secretary of State.

[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=83613e5e6c674c60affe06b5d6083c66&_e=73TXinonUntLgFa2mW1fLXAOl-Ay6INYLVw7giw91BLY6dZLgXgOb7ns3w9L_dultM0TjzcMByWj6QFdaT-PeipQn2VqLgDDCxr-KW_JaDH9RiYGH_8kLOZvUwG7fzV1mcVZADiX5PIYcNgms3vWxrjyjsKT37dGSkFr-JlaNpErEofPVqdi9WAsK4K_t4bss1iJTZDI96c35VDIFG7w9-FF5ZbvvU_4VpixX9UTqpQB0TXhdfyaiMZxvTwxhzqK7ViWyQgXimBC56gOembrQZyCK0BPDU3LT3IWjBz34uuGzC1lc99f9p2-hjFtcaF8USnr0Mm82s0hovKK6wQaDhDRFn2rIA7mUazBjFChKmg7csJzPG97oyxG1cRqBKNf)
So, it is time to really shift this campaign into top gear and utilize the time we have to make our case to Texas Republicans that the future of our state - and this great country - are on the line in the next few months.

That is why I hope you will also take action today - join me on the ramparts of freedom - and support my campaign for Governor of Texas!

There are many ways you can do that, Fellow American - you can pray, which costs nothing but time. You can share our campaign content online and speak to friends and family about what is at stake. You can volunteer and make a difference in person.

[**And, you can make your own endorsement of my campaign - and empower us with the resources we need to build a successful foundation for the tough race ahead with a 2022 Allen West for Governor - with a generous grassroots contribution of $25, $50, $75, $100 or whatever you can afford right now.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=83613e5e6c674c60affe06b5d6083c66&_e=73TXinonUntLgFa2mW1fLXAOl-Ay6INYLVw7giw91BLY6dZLgXgOb7ns3w9L_dultM0TjzcMByWj6QFdaT-PeipQn2VqLgDDCxr-KW_JaDH9RiYGH_8kLOZvUwG7fzV1mcVZADiX5PIYcNgms3vWxrjyjsKT37dGSkFr-JlaNpEcnxHc0RoVNHQayeaBPJhwUk5fWhO7wgG3-u_pobD3GMT0lWfqjSOWvYn58_EehIoSf3uuesXIDiRS7U-6JY1qfnl-7aXgrTeqqXcuYWQEUgY6vR9mguokGWssm_vcfCFQB0k4VCH5O-JLqvX7FNV5of3nEoUmTaWLncdNdQt0Ccw_ix6FBKABiVA6bE-EWr1rpkLH1-MjkPNxrdMkBTFl)

body:
[1]Erica Smith

Last week, we officially launched our campaign to represent North
Carolina’s 2nd District in Congress. Let me tell you why:

NC-02 hasn’t had a Republican congressperson since 1882. But this year,
the NC GOP racially gerrymandered this district to a toss-up — making it
easier for Republicans to win this U.S. House seat and deny us
representation.

Republicans think 2022 is their year. I won’t let that happen.

[ https://act.ericaforus.com/go/27977?refcode=em20211129-655&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=655%2E3698%2EhJSNI3 ]I’m running for Congress because our community won’t be silenced, but I
need you in this fight if we’re going to defeat the GOP. Please, will you
make a contribution to our campaign today?

[ https://act.ericaforus.com/go/27977?refcode=em20211129-655&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=655%2E3698%2EhJSNI3 ]Donate $5

When I was a little girl growing up in North Hampton county, as my family
battled bankruptcy and fought to hold onto the family farm, this community
was here for me.

When I moved home to take care of my dad when he got sick, this community
was here for me.

When I lost my youngest son, those were some of the hardest days of my
life, but this community was here for me.

Now, our community is being confronted with a racial gerrymander that's
trying to rob us of representation. That’s why I’m stepping up and running
for Congress.

I’ve run in a racially
gerrymandered district before — and won. I’ve represented more than half
of the counties in NC-02 in the state senate, and I’ve never lost an
election here. But I’ll need you by my side if I’m going to do it again:

[ https://act.ericaforus.com/go/27977?refcode=em20211129-655&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=655%2E3698%2EhJSNI3 ]Can you chip in whatever makes sense for you right now? Every donation
will help us build the strongest campaign possible to overcome the GOP’s
racial gerrymander and deliver NC-02 for the people.

Thank you,

Erica

Erica Smith
Candidate for North Carolina’s 2nd Congressional District

[ https://act.ericaforus.com/go/27977?refcode=em20211129-655&amp%3Bamounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=655%2E3698%2EhJSNI3 ][IMG]

name: Val Demings
subject: from me to you
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rosen for Nevada
body:
This is the toughest political race of my life, and the future of our Senate majority is on the line.
#
I have a rare 15 minutes, team. Between serving in Congress and running a battleground race for Senate, an empty block of time in my calendar doesn't come around so often.
Sometimes, it means a few minutes in silence to clear my mind and have a decent cup of coffee. Other times it means checking in with my husband, Jerry, or our children and grandchildren. But right now, it means time to reflect on what this race means to me.
Growing up, people like me didn't exactly anticipate serving in Congress. My family and I, we were always just trying to get by. I can close my eyes even now and still picture it: That two-room house in Jacksonville, seven children running around (me, the youngest), and my mom and dad who worked so hard just to put food on the table. Of course life was tough, but we had each other. We had love. We persevered.
I did my part to pull my weight. I worked as a dishwasher in a retirement home when I was 14. At 16, I worked at both Dairy Queen and McDonald's. It was Mom who always said she saw something special in me. She brought out my drive. She told me I was _destined_ for something. How can you ignore a mother's words like that? I sure didn't. Her belief in me has powered my entire life.
My mom, Elouise, is on my mind a lot these days. I think about what she saw in me, what she believed in, when I was just a young girl. I think about the ancestors I never knew who were enslaved people, who _knew_ they wouldn't make it but dreamed and prayed their descendants would. That I would.
My spare minutes are almost up-- so here's what I want to leave you with. Our present is nothing without our past, and that goes double for the future. I know this is a tough race, but I've seen tough up close and personal too many times to count: As a young Black girl who grew up poor in the South to becoming a law enforcement officer of 27 years to being a member of Congress.
Success all comes down to leveraging our very best and fighting our hearts out until the very end -- and I want you to know I'm humbled by the support from each and every one of you. Only in America could a poor, Black girl from the South have a story of opportunity like mine -- and I want every Floridian to have that opportunity, which is why I'm running to be their next Senator. Thanks for this little bit of time. But because this is the toughest political race of my life, and the future of our Senate majority is on the line, you know I can't sign off without asking just once: If you believe in this race, if you believe in me and have faith we can flip Florida blue and win a better future for our state and country, then split whatever you can to my campaign and Jacky Rosen using the following link. Any amount truly helps: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jr-211129-demings**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/39140261/318608194/-1235035064?refcode=jr_em_nd_211129_2&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=Henderson&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4OWMzNWVmMS04ZjUxLWVjMTEtOTgyMC1hMDg1ZmMzMWFjOTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=P_IzZhgxXMrBIJqTwNBg5G244qCXk8zd_08fnqF7KW4=)
Warmly,
Val Demings

name: Tom Norton
subject: My opponent supports vaccine mandates.
body:
Fellow Patriot,
Because of the disaster of the Biden Presidency and corrupt, incompetent leadership among the Democrats around the country, there's a strong possibility that Republicans will retake the majority in Congress in the next election.
But what's the point of retaking the majority if it includes people like my opponent in Michigan's 3rd District, "Republican" Representative Peter Meijer. In his just his first term in Congress he has:
* Voted to impeach President Trump.
* Voted with the Democrats to create their phony January 6 Committee.
* Voted for Red Flag laws to take away your 2nd Amendment Rights without due process.
* Support vaccine mandates that get good people fired and take away our medical liberty.
* Opposes securing our border and building the wall.
* Supports expanding worker visa programs that drive down wages and cost Americans high-skill jobs.

In his short year in Congress, Peter Meijer has voted with Nancy Pelosi more than almost any other Republican.
Is that really who we as part of a "Republican" majority?
That's why I'm challenging Peter Meijer in the Republican Primary. Help me defeat him with a contribution today at [https://tom.gop/donate](https://contacts.tom.gop//l/Oxl6a1Fvy59S6763vIEQrTBw/ZGnsyKvAwpjDwHOnFENslA/MN73sv2892yc5J892I6EjbPIqw).
Who am I?
I grew up here in the district; my family still owns the farm where we raised livestock and grew crops.
After I served in combat in Afghanistan as part of my Michigan Army National Guard unit, I decided to settle in Sand Lake and start a family. We now reside in Ada where my wife and I are the proud parents of two girls and a boy.
I've started several local businesses where I created jobs for other Michiganders, and I have also served as the Sand Lake village president.
I believe in giving back and that's why I co-founded the West Michigan Veterans Ranch. We focus on preventing suicides among our nation's warriors who've returned from combat and to help them find a new purpose in civilian life.
I'm also the leader of the Michigan Conservative Union and have fought to elect conservative, America First patriots to office here in Michigan.
**And I 'm honored to be endorsed in this race by General Michael Flynn. **
But I need your help. And that's why I'm writing you today.
Peter Meijer comes from a wealthy family worth billions of dollars. And while he will surely outspend me, I don't need to outspend him to win, I just need to outwork him, and I promise I will.
However, I still need your financial support to be able to mount a credible campaign. I am not a wealthy man by any means. I'm reaching into my own savings to put $100,000 of my own money into this campaign. That's how much the future of our country means to me. I know it means as much to you.
Please donate online at [https://tom.gop/donate](https://contacts.tom.gop//l/Oxl6a1Fvy59S6763vIEQrTBw/ZGnsyKvAwpjDwHOnFENslA/MN73sv2892yc5J892I6EjbPIqw).
While you may not be from this district or state, remember that Peter Meijer's vote in congress has the same impact on you and your family's life as your own representative's vote.
So please, give what you can to make sure our new Republican Majority is actually Republican at [https://tom.gop/donate](https://contacts.tom.gop//l/Oxl6a1Fvy59S6763vIEQrTBw/ZGnsyKvAwpjDwHOnFENslA/MN73sv2892yc5J892I6EjbPIqw).
Respectfully,

Tom Norton
Republican Candidate for Michigan's 3rd Congressional District
